name: Lomita City Council
agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Tuesday, May 01, 2018 - 06:30 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Council Member Waronek
Roll Call
2.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
3.
PRESENTATIONS
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a five minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2
prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not on the agenda will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL
6.
CITY MANAGER'S REPORT (information only)
7.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
ACTION: That the Consent Calendar Items 7 a-f, be approved.
a.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
b.
Approve the Minutes of the Special Meetings held on April 16, 2017 and April 17, 2018 and the Regular Meeting of April 17, 2018
ACTION: That the minutes be approved.
Item #7b
c.
Approve the Demands and Payroll
ACTION: That the demands and payroll be received and filed.
Item #7c
d.
Consideration of a Letter of Support for Implementation of the State Auditor's Report Recommendations dated March 1, 2018 concerning Storm Water permits
ACTION: To direct the Mayor to sign the attached letters to Assembly Member Al Muratsuchi and Senator Ben Allen, supporting the implementation of the State Auditor's Report recommendations dated March 1, 2018, concerning storm water permits.
Item #7d
e.
Approval of Final Map for Parcel Map No. 74637 at 2374 247th Street
ACTION: That the City Council approve Final Map for Parcel Map No. 74637, as recommended by the City's Engineering consultant, Quantum Consulting, Inc.
Item #7e
f.
Adoption of Resolutions for the City of Lomita's November 6, 2018 General Municipal Election
ACTION: That the City Council adopt the following:
RES 2018-11 - A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita, California, calling for the holding of a General Municipal Election to be held on Tuesday, November 6, 2018 for the election of certain officers as required by the provisions of the laws of the State of California relating to General Law Cities.
Item #7f
PUBLIC HEARINGS:
8.
PUBLIC HEARING - CONSIDERATION OF AN ORDINANCE RELATED TO CONDITIONALLY PERMITTING "BREWERIES AND TASTING ROOMS" WITHIN THE COMMERCIAL RETAIL ZONE AND REVIEW OF CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT NO. 309 FOR A PROPOSED BREWERY AND TASTING ROOM AT 2308 PACIFIC COAST HIGHWAY
Presented by Principal Planner Velasco
ORD NO. 798 - An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Lomita, amending Section 11-1.15.02(B), 11-1.1.48.04(A), and 11-1.1.66.09(C) to define, conditionally permit, and set parking standards for a brewery with tasting room within the CR-Commercial Retail Zone. (First Reading)
RES 2018-14 - A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita approving Conditional Use Permit No. 309 to permit a 3,500 square foot Brewery with Tasting Room, for the property located at 2308 Pacific Coast Highway in the C-R, Commercial Retail Zone. (Initiated and Filed by Brenton Reger, for Project Barley, 820 9th Street, Hermosa Beach, CA 90254).
1.
Introduce first reading of an Ordinance amending Section 1-1.15.02(B), Section 11-1-.48.04(A), and Section 11-1.66.03(C) to define, permit and set parking standards for a "Brewery with Tasting Room" within the Commercial Retail zone subject to a conditional use permit; and
2.
Adoption the resolution approving Conditional Use Permit No. 309 to allow a new 3,500 square foot brewery with tasting room and confirm CEQA categorical exemption.
Item #8
9.
ADJOURNMENT That the City Council meeting be adjourned to the Special Meeting Budget Workshop at 4:45 p.m. to held at City Hall Assembly Room, and then to Regular Meeting to be held on Tuesday, May 15, 2018, at 6:30 p.m. in the Council Chambers of City Hall, 24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA.
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
